meta_title: Ian Shaw Mobile Auto Electrical | Sheffield
meta_description: Ian Shaw Mobile Auto Electrical Services in Sheffield. Mobile diagnostics, alternator repairs, battery replacement, and emergency breakdown cover. Call 07836 688625.
hero_subhead: Breakdown on the M1? Flat battery at home? We come to you across Sheffield — diagnosis and repair on the spot.
services_heading: Mobile Auto Electrical Services Across Sheffield
services_subhead: From emergency breakdown recovery to full diagnostics and repair, we fix your vehicle electrics wherever you are.

services.title: Emergency Breakdown Recovery
services.desc: Flat battery, no ignition, or dead alternator? We attend breakdown calls across Sheffield and get you back on the road fast. No waiting for recovery trucks.

services.title: Battery Testing & Replacement
services.desc: We test your battery on site and fit a replacement if needed. Saves you a trip to the garage and costs less.

services.title: Alternator & Starter Repair
services.desc: Charging trouble or won't start? We diagnose alternator and starter faults on your driveway and repair or replace same day.

services.title: Full Vehicle Diagnostics
services.desc: Computer-aided fault finding for any electrical issue — from warning lights to intermittent problems. You get a clear report and honest advice.

services.title: Wiring & Lighting
services.desc: Rewiring, headlight repairs, interior light fixes, and custom installations. All work carried out to motor industry standards.

services.title: Jump Starts & Roadside Assistance
services.desc: Stranded with a dead battery? We carry jump leads and can get you started in minutes, or tow you to a safe location.

about_pullquote: I started this because breakdown vans were too slow and too expensive.
about_para_1: Ian Shaw has been fixing vehicle electrics across Sheffield for over 15 years. What started as a one-man mobile operation has grown into a trusted service for breakdown recovery and repairs — all from the back of a fully equipped van. Unlike fixed garages, we come to you: home, work, roadside, or customer car park.
about_para_2: We pride ourselves on honest diagnostics and fair prices. No upselling, no guesswork — just proper fault-finding and straightforward repair. Repeat customers and word-of-mouth recommendations make up the bulk of our work, which tells you everything you need to know about how we treat people.

reviews.text: Called Ian out after my battery died at work. He was here in 40 minutes with a new one fitted. Didn't try to charge me a fortune either — refreshing after previous garage rip-offs. Definitely using him again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Broke down on the motorway near Chesterfield. Ian was the first person to get to me with proper equipment. Not only did he jump-start the car, he diagnosed a dodgy alternator and sorted it all for half what Sheffield garages quoted. Legend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Had an intermittent electrical fault driving me mad. Other mechanics couldn't find it. Ian plugged in his diagnostic kit, found the problem in minutes, and fixed it. No drama, no bill shock. Highly recommend him.
reviews.author: David P.
